basis: Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (RefSeq CESA7); RNA in situ in longitudinal vascular strands (Cui 2024 Fig 2E) and top DEG of c16 (log2FC 8.6). c16 likely also holds mechanical fibres: also expect it in sclerenchyma (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (AT5G44030 homolog); c16 log2FC 8.3, no in situ. Also in fibres (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
Chitinase-like 2, secondary-wall cellulose assembly (AT3G16920 homolog); c16 log2FC 8.7, UMAP Supp Fig 5 (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
UDP-xylose transporter for xylan synthesis (AT2G28315 homolog); c16 log2FC 8.3 (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
Secondary-wall MYB; c16 log2FC 5.4. Symbol conflict: DE table says MYB86, Supp Table 3 says MYB103; BLAST best full-length hit is AT1G63910 MYB103 (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
Thermospermine synthase ACAULIS5 of xylem precursors (AT5G19530 homolog); c10 log2FC 6.8, three paralogs also c10-enriched. RefSeq match 98.3%, alt_id not assigned (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
HD-ZIP III ATHB-8, procambium/xylem precursor regulator; c10 log2FC 3.6. RefSeq homeologs 99.6/99.2%, alt_id not assigned (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
REVIEW: hypothesis that c8 is shoot endodermis/starch sheath (gravitropism set IDD14, SGR6, PIN3/4, NPY5); paper calls c8 vascular system. c8 log2FC 4.5 (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
REVIEW: SHOOT GRAVITROPISM 6 homolog (shoot endodermis in Arabidopsis); c8 log2FC 4.8; starch-sheath hypothesis, not validated. RefSeq match 94.5%, alt_id not assigned (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).

REVIEW: auxin efflux carrier, c8 log2FC 4.1; in situ (Fig 2E) is diffuse around the ovule cavity, not a clear sheath. RefSeq names this locus PIN4-like, so the PIN3 symbol is doubtful (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
PROTODERMAL FACTOR1-like (L1 identity); c9 log2FC 6.2, no in situ (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
Cuticular lipid exporter ABCG11/WBC11 homolog; c9 log2FC 6.7. RefSeq match 96.4%, alt_id not assigned (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
PDR-type ABCG32/PEC1 homolog (cuticle formation); c9 log2FC 3.5 (paper symbol PDR1) (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
Wax alkane synthesis CER3 homolog; c9 log2FC 4.1. RefSeq match 90.9%, alt_id not assigned (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
Suberin glycerol-3-phosphate acyltransferase; c18 log2FC 9.8, a suberized outer layer that appears only after soil entry (paper: periderm; phellogen not shown) (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
Suberin fatty-acid omega-hydroxylase CYP86A1 (RefSeq-confirmed symbol); c18 log2FC 9.8 (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
Suberin-associated R2R3 MYB93 homolog; c18 log2FC 7.4 (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).

VLCFA elongase KCS1; c18 log2FC 6.6. Conflict: in situ (Supp Fig 5) labels a subepidermal pericarp band AND the ovule integuments, so it is not specific to c18 tissue; also check Seed_Coat (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).

SHP/AGL5-like MADS; in situ in the inner shell wall (Cui 2024 Fig 5G); c17 log2FC 2.7 with broad background (text says c0). Conflict: Jin et al. 2025 preprint uses the same gene (LOC112795288) as an ovule marker.
SEP3-like MADS (DE table: MADS4); c17 log2FC 7.2. Conflict: Jin et al. 2025 preprint uses LOC112734872 (identical protein) as an ovule marker. Two RefSeq loci share this protein, alt_id not assigned.
SHP/AG-clade MADS (DE table: MADS1; best Arabidopsis hits AGL1/AGL5); c17 log2FC 2.5 with broad background (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).

REVIEW: type I MADS AGL80-like (central cell/endosperm in Arabidopsis); c20 log2FC 12.7, other clusters ~0, with defensin-like and other secreted small peptides. Hypothesis that c20 is endosperm/female gametophyte; the review had called it an artifact (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
Mitotic-chromosome 3xHMG-box protein (AT4G23800 homolog); c5 (G2/M; paper: meristem) log2FC 5.2; in situ in ovule/seed rings (Fig 2E) (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
Mitotic kinesin ATK5/KIN-10A; c5 log2FC 5.3 (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
Replication-dependent histone H3; c4 (S phase; paper: embryo) log2FC 3.8. Several RefSeq loci share this protein, alt_id not assigned (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
DEK chromatin protein; c4 log2FC 3.4; in situ in the embryo/nucellus core of the young seed (Supp Fig 5), so c4 is probably S-phase cells of the young seed (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
Chalcone synthase; c14 (paper: tip tissue; purple peg tip) log2FC 9.3. A pigmentation state, not a tissue. RefSeq match 96.1%, alt_id not assigned (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).
Anthocyanidin reductase (RefSeq-confirmed); c14 log2FC 8.7 (Cui et al. 2024 Plant Commun).

REVIEW: NAC1/ANAC021-22 homolog; c19 log2FC 4.7 (paper: cuticular layer). Cui in situ (Supp Fig 5) labels the outer pericarp layers and ovule integuments; Jin et al. 2025 preprint in situ (LOC112703413, identical protein) is too low-resolution to assign a type. Cell type unresolved.
